title: 第17章 枕边风
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
次日巳时。

    青云宗，内门百事殿。

    齐子濯在殿前长廊上踱步徘徊，显得有些不安，布满皱纹的苍老额头浮现细汗。

    进出大殿的门人络绎不绝，偶有认识的弟子路过打招呼，他只是嘴角扯出牵强笑意颔首回应。

    此刻，距离苏牧被执法殿带走已经过去将近八个时辰，事情远比他预想的严重。

    齐子濯在青云宗虽然是一名普通长老，但好歹待了两百年，积攒了一些人脉资源。

    然而，他去往执法殿数次，凭借他的关系，别说走后门求情，连苏牧人都没见到。

    甚至，他自己都被执法殿盘问了许多事情。

    眼下他只能寄希望于百事殿的首席长老冯远清，却也不抱乐观心态。

    因为他托人探听到了大致消息，执法殿不是简单怀疑苏牧抓去审问，而是有了确凿的人证和物证！

    齐子濯抬手用袖口贴了贴耳侧的热汗，内心生出一丝悔意，后悔撮合婚事，还主动散布消息，如今外门有不少人知道苏牧和齐云溪定下了婚约，即将成为道侣。

    他自己行将就木、黄土埋到了脖子，已然无所谓，却怕事情影响到玄孙女，所托非人。

    若不是齐云溪梨花带泪苦苦哀求，他真可能就此放任不管，避而远之。

    “哎~”

    齐子濯叹了口气，转念一想，若是苏牧顺利度过此劫，将来应当会更看重齐云溪，真心相待。

    时间一点点地流逝，日头移动，时至晌午。

    远空一道长虹呼啸飞来，瞬息而至，落在大殿前，两个男子有说有笑走向门户。

    齐子濯脚步一顿，抬起右手又硬生生止住悬在半空，忍住没有出声。

    又等了一炷多香，身穿紫金锦袍的冯远清一个人从大殿内走了出来。

    “冯师兄！”齐子濯快步上前。

    冯远清一副中年面孔，五官中正，面相看着和善，闻得叫喊扭头看去，微微怔了怔，拱手还了一礼，客气道：“是齐师兄啊。”

    见对方记得自己，齐子濯不禁暗自松了口气，露出笑容摆手示意道：“师兄可否借一步说话。”

    冯远清身为百事殿首席长老，位高权重，但年龄却不大，才八十多岁，已臻至筑基圆满半步金丹境，曾经是宗门天骄，如今成了宗门肱股中坚。
content_en:
It's about time the next day.

    Qingyun Sect, the inner gate of Baishi Hall.

    Qi Zizuo was pacing on the corridor in front of the palace, looking a little uneasy, with a thin layer of sweat appearing on his wrinkled old forehead.

    There was an endless stream of disciples entering and exiting the hall, and occasionally a disciple he knew passed by to say hello, but he just nodded and responded with a forced smile.

    At this moment, nearly eight hours had passed since Su Mu was taken away by the Law Enforcement Hall, and the matter was far more serious than he expected.

    Although Qi Zizuo was an ordinary elder in Qingyun Sect, he had stayed there for two hundred years and accumulated some network resources.

    However, he went to the Law Enforcement Hall several times. With his connections, he didn't even see Su Muren, let alone asking for mercy through the back door.

    Even, he himself was questioned about many things by the Law Enforcement Hall.

    At the moment, he can only place his hope on Feng Yuanqing, the chief elder of Pepsi Hall, but he is not optimistic either.

    Because he asked someone to find out the general information, the Law Enforcement Hall did not simply suspect Su Mu and arrest him for interrogation, but had conclusive witness and physical evidence!

    Qi Zizhuo raised his hand and pressed the cuff of his sleeve against the hot sweat next to his ear. He felt a trace of regret in his heart. He regretted arranging the marriage and taking the initiative to spread the news. Now many people in the outer sect knew that Su Mu and Qi Yunxi had made an engagement and were about to become Taoist couples.

    He himself was dying, and the loess was buried up to his neck. He didn't care anymore, but he was afraid that the matter would affect his great-great-granddaughter, and he would be entrusted to someone else.

    If Qi Yunxi Lihua hadn't begged with tears in her eyes, he might have just let her go and stayed away.

    "Hey~"

    Qi Zizhao sighed, and then thought, if Su Mu successfully survives this disaster, he will value Qi Yunxi more in the future and treat him sincerely.

    Time passed little by little, the sun moved, and it was noon.

    A long rainbow roared from the far sky, arrived in an instant, and landed in front of the main hall. Two men walked toward the door while talking and laughing.

    Qi Zi paused, raised his right hand and stopped it hanging in mid-air, holding back no sound.

    After waiting for another stick of Duoxiang, Feng Yuanqing, wearing a purple and gold brocade robe, walked out of the hall alone.

    "Senior Brother Feng!" Qi Zizuo stepped forward quickly.

    Feng Yuanqing had a middle-aged face, with normal features and a kind face. When he heard the shout, he turned his head and looked around. He was slightly startled. He returned the salute with his hand and said politely: "It's Senior Brother Qi."

    Seeing that the other party remembered him, Qi Zizhao couldn't help but secretly breathed a sigh of relief. He smiled and waved his hand and said, "Senior brother, can you take a step to speak."

    As the chief elder of Pepsi Hall, Feng Yuanqing holds a high position of authority, but he is still young. He is only over eighty years old. He has reached the half-step golden elixir level of Foundation Establishment. He was once the genius of the sect, but now he has become the backbone of the sect.
